positions.title: Mobile Software Engineer
positions.description:
Technologies: iOS, Swift, Objective-C

♣	Designed iOS application with a projected user base of well over 1.5 million active users 

♣	Grew expertise in leveraging multiple geolocation technologies for different business objectives 

♣	Developed applications to utilize custom geolocation and mapping technologies to query 
and harmoniously map more than 700 locations at a time

♣	Increased understanding of user interface design for an effective and simplistic user experience

♣	Co-product managed design choices and architected application development accordingly

♣	Adopted Agile software development methodology from an experienced Specialist to influence 
a flexible and organized development workflow

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Technologies: Android, Java, SQL, Python

♣	Developed android application to create an interactive interface between the company and 
the customer taking on 90% of shipping based business

♣	Developed and customized applications to streamline required customer shipping documentation

positions.title: Sequence Engineering Aide
positions.description:
Technologies: .NET, Visual Basic, SQL, JavaScript for Acrobat 

♣	Developed automation programs in Visual basic to assign inventory of customer request indicating 
company-wide work objectives saving the company 200k a year in profit

♣	Designed custom utilities to eliminate manual processes by 100% during times of company 
wide emergencies such as Hurricane Sandy and natural caused power outages 

♣	Designed interactive spreadsheets and evaluation forms in daily circulation to increase efficiency
and provide clear understanding
